We updated our Unity engine to include the latest security fix. This prevents a rare potential exploit, which has not been reported to occur yet.
Major improvements to the performance of enemy movement logic. While enemies should move and behave mostly the same, they will now consume less processing power to achieve the same results.
Enemies in the Arsenal (Practice Room, Free Mode, accessible via the Architect Chamber) now have some chance to spawn as elite variants.
Fixed an issue where the sound for certain traps and the slime boss was not playing as intended in some cases.
Fixed typos in some item descriptions.

Hello, this is the patch notes on the recent hotfixes and updates made to the game. This posting was delayed because we wanted the 1.1 version announcement to be the first visible news for returning players and new players.
We always appreciate your feedback and will work to fix the issues you've reported.
Fixed an issue where the settings menu would show a black screen if the computer detected that you were using a newly added localization.
Fixed an issue where non-pixel fonts for certain languages were not properly displayed
Fixed an issue where the Dungeon Architect would not properly change equipment with certain new outfits and accessories.
Added '(Hold)' to the Survivor upgrade button prompt to clearly indicate its function.
Fixed an issue where items could be obtained immediately in certain cases, which could happen if the frame rate was set in specific ways.
Fixed some odd floor visuals and shading in the Architect Chamber.
Moved the floating candle to a more appropriate position.
Fixed an issue where you could recycle the wrong item in the inventory if you moved the chosen item at the exact moment the recycling process was initiated.

Adjusted the visuals of the upgrade and recycling meters to briefly stay full before completing the upgrade or recycling, to better convey progress. The meter fill speed has been increased, so the time it takes to upgrade or recycle remains the same.
Fixed an issue where certain enemies' deaths counted twice due to the level-ending handling of specific situations.
Fixed a few odd pixels on various disk images.
Fixed a few missing tiles in the Arsenal (sandbox area).
The audio system in the game will no longer generate logs in the backend.
Fixed an issue where the elemental effect on the Player could persist across the menu if the menu scene was navigated too quickly.

Fixed an issue in the Arsenal (Sandbox area) where dying in a certain way could dim the game's lighting, which would remain that way until the correct menu was processed or the application was restarted.
Fixed an issue where you could block the progress of the tutorial by crafting two spells instead of crafting artifacts in extreme circumstances.
Fixed the position of some wall torches in the rooms before the Dungeon Architect.
Hello, everyone!
1.1 Version of Spell Disk is our biggest update yet, and we're excited to share new features and adjustments for the experienced players of Spell Disk.
The Custom Dungeon Builder has been added to the Root Chamber. It becomes accessible after completing the end-game mission, which is unlocked by defeating the Dungeon Architect three times.

Before starting a regular run, players can modify various aspects of the game, such as enemy population or dungeon depth. These new Custom Dungeon Builder modifiers can stack independently from danger level modifiers. Since these changes significantly alter the game's internal systems, progress cannot be saved during the run. Additionally, the completion of a Custom Mode run will not be recorded as a memory in the Architect Chamber for Infinity Dungeon or Arena.
To make room for the new builder, the Tutorial Recaller—used much less frequently—has been relocated elsewhere in the Root Chamber.
The Arsenal area has been added. It can be accessed from the Architect Chamber after completing the end-game mission, which is unlocked by defeating the Dungeon Architect three times.

Players can obtain any discovered items, wear unlocked outfits and accessories, and equip any weapons they’ve found to test their dream build. They can also summon enemies to fight. In essence, it will serve as a sandbox mode for Spell Disk!
Dummy maker in the Architect Chamber has been reworked.
The Time Stone has been added. The stone can be interacted with to adjust the speed of time itself. Adjusting its strength will either accelerate everything in the game or return it to normal speed.

Its unlock conditions differ between the two game modes: in the regular mode, players must defeat the Dungeon Architect once, while in Survivor Mode, clearing a high enough danger level unlocks the stone next to the portal.
New equippable items can be obtained by defeating certain enemies:
Flower Outfit: Defeat the Explosive Seed Flower.
Chronomancer Outfit: Defeat the Royal Magician.
Cone Hat: Defeat the Cone Hat Swordsmen.
Bonehelm: Defeat the Ossified Wolf.
The Electromancer Outfit's orbs have been optimized and graphically updated.
The Pyromancer Outfit's burn damage has been increased, and burn damage will now be recognized as applying fire affliction. Its graphics and audio feedback have also been updated.
Added German localization.
Added French localization.
Added Traditional Chinese localization.
Changed the displayed language in the language selection menu to show each language in its native form.

We want to extend our heartfelt thanks to the translators who helped localize Spell Disk. If you notice any significant errors in the new languages, please let us know, and we’ll ensure they are addressed in future updates.
Text areas have been adjusted and improved to reduce odd line breaks in certain languages.
Rewrote various item descriptions so that they are more consistent throughout the game.(e.g. Assault Cuisse: Deal damage to enemy passed through Dash -> Player Dash can deal damage to enemies.)

Various pixel graphics have been updated to remove odd pixels and improve overall clarity. Additionally, various in-game icons have been reworked or replaced for enhanced consistency and clarity. For instance, the affliction icons for both the spell upgrade modifier and the stat will now appear similar to each other, rather than using distinctive icons from different graphic assets.

The enemy's idle and movement animation speed is now capped at 300%. Idling at a faster speed looked a bit off, so this is purely a visual change. Enemies will still attack at speeds higher than 300% during their attacks.

notes.title: Steam Community Items & Points Shop Items

items.text: Due to player demand, we decided to add Trading Cards and Steam Points Shop Items for Spell Disk. Come and check it out!
Added Community Items: Badge, 15 trading cards, 3 profile backgrounds, and 10 emoticons.
Added Points Shop Exclusive Items: Animated Avatar, Animated Profile Background, Animated Mini Profile Background, 6 stickers, and 3 Animated Avatar Frames.
This adjustment mostly focuses on improving the strength of melee or weapon attack builds, which were significantly far too weak compared to regular spell-disk builds.
Increased the mana rewards of Attack Multi-Hit Disk (35 -> 45)
Increased the mana rewards of Combo Hit Disk (2 -> 3)
Increased the mana rewards of Finisher Creation Disk (45 -> 60)
Increased the mana rewards of Finisher Damage Disk (200% -> 250%)
Increased the mana rewards of Finisher Finished Disk (35 -> 60)
Increased the mana rewards of Finisher Hit Disk (55 -> 60)
Increased the mana rewards of Bell Disk (15 -> 20)
Increased the mana rewards of Warrior Disk (30 -> 40)
Apprentice Glove : (40 -> 50%) Increased attack speed.
Auto Charge Gauntlet : Charge speed increased (35 -> 45)
Bard's Glove : Charging increased attack speed + weapon damage. Increased maximum value (75 -> 100)
Crescent Hat : Increased effectiveness (2% -> 3%) & Increased max value (100% -> 150%)
Finisher Caster : Reduced cooldown (0.25 -> 0.2 seconds).
Hidden Bomb: Reduced cooldown (1 -> 0.75 seconds). Increased damage of explosions (20 -> 25). Now counts as "Physical" type.
Phantom Rapier : Reduced cooldown (0.5 -> 0.4 seconds). Rapier attacks spawn slightly further from the player.
Sword Sheath : Increased weapon attack damage (60 -> 75) & Increased stun power (100 -> 150)
Berserker Glove : Increased maximum attack speed (100 -> 150). Increased reset timer (1.5 -> 2 seconds)
Elven Footwear : Increased attack speed per dash (15 -> 20) Max is 150 still.
Horned Gem : Increased maximum attack speed (100 -> 150).
Goat Hood : Max damage buff increased (200 -> 300). Now provides 10% attack speed naturally.
Raging Armband : Increased maximum attack speed (50 -> 100).
Warrior's Mask : Increased attack speed buff (100 -> 150).

Wisps and other creatures from summoning spells will no longer be affected by enemy movement speed modifiers. They will not be slowed by your own spells, nor will they gain extra speed from difficulty modifiers.
All item data, enemy data, and boss data have had unnecessary data removed for faster loading and handling.
A boss's dodge maneuver will now activate based on its current health percentage rather than its base health percentage.
Some collision layers have been adjusted for Root Chamber and Architect Chamber objects to optimize collision calculations.
Fixed an issue where Cold Pants and Poison Flask would internally accumulate objects, causing frame drops if used extensively after clearing a level.
Fixed unintended rare collider interactions that caused some objects to freeze in the code.
Fixed various internal error issues that may or may not be noticeable at the conclusion of Survivor Mode.
Fixed an issue where Headband Soldier could slide off the wall bounds in extreme cases.
Fixed an issue where ground-level hitting spells triggered an unnecessary log error in the background when hitting certain level objects, such as an item altar.
Fixed an issue where the player could walk out of bounds in the Dungeon Architect boss room.

Fixed an issue where, under extreme circumstances, removing enemies after the end of the level could cause an unnecessary error log in the background (which wouldn’t have affected gameplay in most cases).
Fixed an issue where the Chronomancer class in Survivor Mode could not register the stat of disk activation.
Vase, Jar, or Pot will now break after receiving a certain amount of affliction damage, rather than enduring infinite damage.
Clay Magician’s projectiles will no longer attract targeting spells.
Certain weapon-attack-dependent spells won’t be available as starting spells in Survivor mode.
The first stage behind the gate will now have music instead of silence.
The cooldown for Shock Dasher artifact has been slightly increased.
The Additional Spell modifier has been removed from Seeking Fire's upgrade pool.
Fixed an issue where you could stack charge attacks of the axe with the Snake Ring equipped.

Fixed an issue where Collector's gem in survivor mode would sometimes throw an error upon leveling up. Additionally, the movement of the gem has been changed to be more consistent with the physics engine.

Fixed an issue where Shock Dasher was creating a lot more lightning chains than intended when using dashing spells. Fixed the behavior to be affected by cooldown as stated in the item description. Reduced the cooldown interval of the Shock Dasher.
The elemental debuff from the Cryomancer Outfit's effect will be removed upon changing the outfit.
Internal code cleanups and changes for a future update.
Fixed an issue where, in rare cases, the Survivor mode upgrade malfunctioned when an upgrade greater than level 5 was obtained.
Trembler's shockwave in Survivor mode will now work with the Stun Disk and Knockback Disk.
Fixed an issue where the Copycat Outfit would not copy the first instance of Spear's charged attack.
The Pumpkin Head accessory will no longer explode after clearing the level, as exploding around while there's no threat caused inconvenience.
Jester Hood's attack effect will register as an attack performed by the player, so it will interact with attack-perform-conditional items.
Updated the item pool of the Deranged class in survivor mode. Some artifacts that synergize with disks will not appear.
Fixed an issue where some traps threw an error when hit by specific spells.
Shield loss over time on certain classes or items will activate shield loss effects.
Fixed an issue where the poison arrow would sometimes make an enemy invincible when the poisoned enemy is spawned again in quick succession under rare circumstances.
Minor optimization of game source code.
Addressed an issue where the Sturdy Potion could not remove the player's stun on rare occasions.
Fixed an issue where the Deranged class in Survivor Mode had disks appear in their rewards after the recent item pool change.
Optimized the stun and knockback mechanism for players to reduce redundant functions.
Unified the internal handling of all achievements in the game.
Adjusted and optimized codes related to Steamworks (verification, community tab, etc).
Fixed an issue where Moose Antler accessory would reset to 0 power immediately when equipped with the Auto Charge Gauntlet. Beginning a charging attack will now reset to 0 instead.
Fixed an issue where some tutorial texts went beyond walls.
Fixed an issue where the inventory key instruction was not properly updated in the tutorial.
Fixed an issue with lightning wisp and electromaner outfit + accessory equipped.
Adjusted the text size and length of level modifiers in all languages.
Fixed an issue where having multiple controllers attached to the device made certain game texts invisible.
Fixed an issue where the buttons were not properly updated (Inventory) in rare cases.
Minor optimizations to some internal codes.

Added an option to set the button icons of the game in the settings menu. By default, it's set to auto-detect, so it won't change anything for most players. For people who have issues with their PlayStation controller appearing as Xbox buttons, they can manually set the button icon types in the settings menu for the button layout of their liking.
Improved the icons within the settings menu.
Fixed an issue where the language for certain options in the settings menu was not properly being updated after changing the game language.
Fixed an issue where Vital Pack and other "unequipped items" had trouble tracking unequipped items when obtaining items with no available slots.
Fixed an issue with Jester's Fleeting Feet providing a movement speed buff if entering the boss room while charging an attack.
Minor improvements to game texts, and typo corrections.

Fixed an issue where the tutorial would get stuck at the reroll item instruction. Due to recent changes made to indicate the 'Architect Items,' an unexpected interaction occurred, resulting in an error with the tutorial items.

Auto Charge Gauntlet will work with various 'while charging' items. Also, the artifact will continue to 'charge' while it is equipped even after being fully charged. Its rarity increased to two stars.
Bard's Glove (increased attack speed & weapon damage while charging) will work with Auto Charge Gauntlet.
Gem Caller (increase collection range and continuously spawns void gems) will work with Auto Charge Gauntlet.
Grace Guard (50% defense on idle / charging) will work with Auto Charge Gauntlet. Added outline effect while the buff is active.
Jester's Fleeing Feet (specified in the description to "while player is charging") will work with Auto Charge Gauntlet.
Lion Guard Shield (will continuously generate shield) will work with Auto Charge Gauntlet.
Wind Glove (increased dash stamina regeneration while charging) will work with Auto Charge Gauntlet. Added outline effect while the buff is active.
Fixed a rare issue where using Chilled Pool spell while only equipping unlinked disks led to some unexpected errors, such as enemies being unhittable.

Added an optional "Architect Item" indicator in the game settings menu. By enabling "Show Dungeon Architect's Item" in the game settings panel of the settings screen, items will be shown with a golden square border if they have been used to defeat the Dungeon Architect in the past. The default state of this option is set to be turned off, so you'll have to enable the option in the settings first.

Fixed a major issue where certain wall-detecting spells in the survivor mode didn't function properly, resulting in infinite projectile travel distance. This caused severe frame drops as the game went on as the instance could not be recycled efficiently. This has been fixed.

Changed the item drop rates for the survivor mode. New items may appear even if all item slots are equipped with items. The chance of new items will decrease with the amount of items held in the inventory. Overall, this change will make it possible to further optimize your build later in the survivor mode, making the level up more exciting when all item slots have been equipped.

Fixed an issue where obtaining treasure chests in the survivor mode while having no empty inventory space and picking a new item resulted in the vanishment of chosen item. The treasure chest will now offer the upgrades of equipped items as an only option.
Adjusted the item pool of the Trembler class in the survivor mode. Stun damage-type disks were difficult to activate due to their stun-ramping mechanic, so they were removed from the pool.
The Collector's gem will now rotate toward the player's direction instead of rotating slowly all the time.

Slightly increased the chance of new items appearing when all item slots are equipped. Also, adjusted the distribution of item types to be more responsive to the type of item that the player has the least of.
Fixed an issue that occurred when the Shield Heal Disk was unequipped under certain conditions.
Optimized collider type checking (enemy, player, wall, etc.) to be more memory efficient.
Stopped colliders from reconstructing themselves each time the axis is updated, which caused massive frame drops in certain computer configurations.

Disabled a function that removed all enemies after clearing a level. By the time the top UI panel is fading away, the player would see that all enemy-related objects, if somehow still present, are forcefully removed. This caused an unintended interaction with the summonable minions, which in a very rare case caused an error where the next floor level would not function normally.

Summonable minions will no longer be summoned while the elevator is in motion or the level is loading. This change will not affect normal gameplay and will prevent issues that might occur when summonable minions are created as the level is about to be unloaded/loaded in the game.
Slow traps will not flash along with the damage flash.
Fixed an issue unbanning all items in the architect chamber by interacting with the book would refund all the root chamber upgrades.
Fixed an issue the game would sometimes reset the ban list when launching the game application because the save data was loaded before the ban list was initialized.

Added ITEM BAN SYSTEM for item pool in the compendium. You can unlock the feature by defeating Dungeon Architect for the first time. The maximum ban amount for each item type equals your greatest danger level cleared. While the danger level can increase indefinitely, the maximum ban items will maxed out at 25. You may only change your ban item list while there is no ongoing run in the game.
Only items that have defeated the Dungeon Architect (indicated by the golden border in the Compendium) can be banned.
Changed the golden border color for defeating the Dungeon Architect with the items. It is a requirement for banning items, thus it was beneficial for it to be more visible.

All banned items can be unbanned using the compendium interactive object in the Architect Chamber. The object also serves as a reminder to let players know of such feature after having defeating Dungeon Architect.
Added "Banned" item types in the Compendium's sort mode. This sorting will only appear if one or more item has been banned.
Added "Architect" item types in the Compendium's sort mode. This sorting will only appear if one or more item has been used to defeat Dungeon Architect.
Setting sort to None ("--") in the Compendium will reset the item back to its initial order, which is based on their internal database order.
Fixed some artifact items such as Lava Trousers activating more times than the intended amount.
Fixed an issue with the shop camera when exiting the shop scene via the menu while the camera is moving toward the shopkeeper.
Added additional measures for the enemy manager (which operates levels) to ignore the player's summoned minions.
Set the fallback level logic (when choosing from the three types of defeat: time, wave) to the defeat (red bar) level.
Removed DoTween dependencies on the enemy manager on each level.
Adjusted the script compiling order of the enemy manager on each level.
Void stone item attribute tag fixed to not include charge attack.
Gem Rod artifact will count down toward zero instead of counting up. Also, specified the description more clearly.
Changed the description of Trapper Potion artifact. The effect remains unchanged.
Fixed some other minor typo, descriptions, and inconsistencies in the description.
Gem spells, which get affected by gem drop rate, no longer receive negative modifiers in infinity dungeon or other game modes.
Fixed an issue with the pyromancer cap not recording the spell's affliction performance on physical spells.

Fixed an issue sometimes mana produced for disk stat was not being properly recorded. The cause was that after the battle scene was over, the disk activation count was being counted while the disk mana generation was not being counted.Optimized several item performance related codes.Fixed an issue where various errors would occur if summoning multiple summons in the lobby (Root Chamber, Tree Branch Chamber, etc) area.
Fixed an issue with Gem Caller artifact. Some of its effects will no longer linger and be effective when the item is removed.

Added sorting feature in the compendium. When pressing the Charged Attack button while viewing an item in the compendium, the compendium will sort the order of displayed items based on the item tags they possess.
Changed the visual for the weapon compendium slots to make the weapons more visible, increasing their size as well.
Fixed various description inconsistencies and improved the wording of various old item descriptions in all languages.
Added Shield Heal Disk back into the item pool, as it was previously mistakenly taken out from the item pool.

Changed Fullscreen mode ON/OFF to different display modes. Please be aware that due to this change, the default fullscreen mode will be set to borderless fullscreen mode regardless of your previous saved choice. Now, instead of toggling fullscreen, you can choose from the following three options:
Borderless: Default fullscreen behavior. Enabling this mode will create black bars around the corners if the resolution does not match the monitor resolution.

Fullscreen: This new fullscreen behavior, also known as Exclusive Fullscreen, disables your desktop to further optimize the game. You may gain some performance benefits when this mode is selected at the cost of some convenience (background apps might not run as expected, as the computer will attempt to concentrate its resources on running Spell Disk smoothly). However, this exclusive fullscreen mode will always attempt to fit the monitor entirely, so it is crucial that you're using the aspect ratio same as the monitor you're using. Otherwise, you may see some stretched or squashed images throughout the game.
Windowed: Regular windowed mode. You can move the window around as you'd expect from a windowed application.

If you're running the game on a platform other than Windows (such as iOS or Linux), choosing the new Exclusive Fullscreen mode will default the fullscreen mode to the regular 'borderless' fullscreen mode. This is because exclusive fullscreen mode is not supported on other platforms.

Added some changes to support widescreen. Please be aware that we still recommend playing the game in a 16:9 aspect ratio. These adjustments and changes mostly will not affect any players who played the game on a 16:9 aspect ratio.
The game scene will attempt to align to the center instead of the right corner of the screen when using an ultrawide screen.
Adjusted the UI orientation of the end result screens on ultrawide screen aspect ratio.
Adjusted the size of Level Modifier UI on ultrawide screen aspect ratio.
Adjusted the location of the circle light on the wardrobe on ultrawide screen aspect ratio.
Fixed an issue where button navigation to the left was disabled when opening and closing the language tab.
Fixed a typo in the Sword Sheath artifact and Mage Shield artifact.
Fixed various item description inconsistencies in certain languages.
Fixed an issue Void Wisp had an unusual amount of duration.
Adjusted strength of stout helm and grace guard artifact in the survivor mode only, to avoid making it possible to reach 100% damage reduction from all sources.
Internal logging behavior disabled to further optimize the game.
Other code clean ups and minor optimizations.
Fixed an issue with the Elemental Trident artifact, which was displaying an erroneous amount of affliction for elemental power disks.
Renamed the spell "Volatile Shell" to "Volatile Gem" and updated its description. Fixed an issue where the volatile shell was exploding more times than intended.
Adjusted the wording of various spells to ensure consistency with other uses.
Adjusted the wording of Echo Blade and Twin Caster's notes to maintain consistency across languages.
Adjusted the tutorial wording to match the game's standard usage in certain languages.
Removed "Caster" wording from item descriptions to improve clarity.
Adjusted the wording of Scorching Aura, Shivering Aura, and Sword Spin.
Changed the item name of Sword Sheath in certain languages.
Removed unnecessary empty spaces from some item descriptions.
Updated the descriptions of items to be more clear.
Fixed stagger and impact values for Void Wisp spell.
Fixed the colliders of the stairs in certain rooms in the Summoning Chamber levels.

Merged the reviewer branch with the default branch of the game application. The reviewer branch was used as a beta test before the full release of the game, so it had no differences from the default branch since the game's release.

Added a starting spell reroll feature for the survivor mode. Upon unlocking the endless mode in the survivor mode (by defeating the survivor mode boss at Danger Level 5), an interactable object will appear below the starting spells, where you can spend 10 insight points to reroll the starting spells.
Forest Blessed artifact adjusted from 65% to 70%.
Fixed an issue where the scepter weapon image was missing on the memory gem.
Optimized the critical chance and damage display in the stat panel.
Hovering over spells with critical chance upgrades will show their sum of bonus critical chance as an addition to the base critical chance. (example: 25% upgrade will appear as 10% + 25%)
Hovering over a weapon spell while having the Architect Hat equipped will display 0% critical chance for better clarity of the accessory's effects.
Fixed an issue where the Architect outfit was not using the intended reduced critical damage multiplier.
Slow trap zone size slightly increased and graphics pixelated to be consistent with the game's art direction.
The Bestial Embrace artifact will immediately update the critical chance upon equipping the item in the inventory. Adjusted the effectiveness of the artifact.
Fixed the description of the Cold Potency Disk in certain languages.
Fixed a rare issue that could occur with certain controller configurations.
Adjusted the outline thickness of all artifact icons to be pixel-perfect.

Most of the artifacts that occur in every event will now count down toward zero, instead of some counting upward and some counting downward. This change reversed the counter for the following artifacts: Gem Grenade, Void Stone, Dagger Locket, War Hammer.
Activation indication is Artifact Icon UI above the Player's Health bar getting bigger and smaller on certain instances. Various activating artifacts now have it.
Added activation indicator for Attacker's Delight artifact when it is activated via creating a last-combo attack type object.
Added indicator for Auto Charge Gauntlet artifact when it is fully charged.
Maximum value of Blood Claw artifact has been added to its description.
Blue Blouse, Yellow Blouse, Red Blouse artifacts will show activation indication when their respective elemental status has been applied.
Burst Gazer artifact buffed by making the time it takes to activate the explosion shorter.
Added activation indicator for Elixir artifacts.
Crossbow artifact will show activation indication on shooting crossbow arrows.
Dual Edges artifact will show activation indication when the blade has been spawned.
Deer Helmet artifact will display the amount of buff the player is receiving, either from the attack speed or movement speed. The number displayed will show the greater of the two.
Fixed an issue with Gem Grenade artifact's sound effect volume issue.
Power Cannon artifact will display the greatest damage dealt to the enemy in between activations.
Increased the effectiveness of Gladiator's Glory (100% -> 150% last combo attack damage).
Added activation indicator for Jester Hood.
Librarian Codex now has numerical and color indicators for its elemental damage buffs.
Crested Helm artifact will show outline while performing a combo attack.

Moon Chain artifact now has an activation indicator on performing multiple last-combo attacks. Fixed an issue where Necronomicon artifact was counting one more than necessary and added an outline to indicate readiness for activation.
Old Mage's Hat artifact now has an activation indicator on casting additional weapon spells.
Pirate Hat will display the critical damage bonus from the critical chance.

Adjusted the behavior of Verdant Armor. Now, taking a hit before its previous healing duration was still in effect will cancel the previous healing timer. Hence, taking a lot of consecutive hits will make the artifact less useful, while it will remain the same for occasional hits. Outline effects have been added to indicate its healing phase.
Added sound effect for Triplet Shield's damage negation, which is the same as the normal shield sound effect. Changed Triplet Shield's indicator from numerical one to outline.
Fixed an issue where the Bunny outfit would not jump properly when performing combo attacks with the Katar weapon equipped.
Goat Hood's function has been corrected to fit its description. Also added a numerical counter for its current buff.

Implemented the corrupted save data restoration function inside the game. Ideally, you'll never get to see the new error screen and the icon above, but it will help those who are having issues with corrupted save data file issues.

Separated the DASH button from the ITEM/MENU SELECTION button for control. The game will automatically assign the same control for dashing upon starting any version after 1.0.1. Please note that you may need to rebind your menu confirm button if your dash was bound to any of the mouse buttons. Your dash buttons remain the same, but your new menu confirmation key will be set to the default Space key. This change will affect:
Inventory item selection button.
Main Menu Selection.
Game Over Menu Selection.
Survivor Game Over Menu Selection.
Pause Scene Selection.
Setting Scene Selection.

Other buttons that required players to push the dash button, such as wardrobe and memory gem, remain unchanged. We considered those aspects of the game 'in-game' instead of 'menu', and also they do not require frequent inputs for navigation.
Fixed an issue in rare cases where the changed controller key in the inventory was not properly updated after changing the control while the game is ongoing.
Fixed an issue assigning a new control as the same key as before, which removed the control for the key instead of resetting back to its previous control.
Fixed the description of the Charging Complete Disk.
The Disk's green fill will update its filled amount one more time after triggering to account for leftover mana.
Fixed an issue where the game would break if the player attempted to return to the main menu while the elevator transition was ongoing.
Fixed an issue the last chosen appearance-only outfit and accessories were not being saved on Continue.
Adjusted the behavior of Necronomicon artifact so that it cannot sometimes disrupt auto weapon spell casting.
Removed Magic Gun artifact and Disk Activation Disk from Chronomancer's item pool.
Corrected the description of Cold Power Disk in certain languages.

Improved and optimized Enemy explodes on death modifier explosion. Graphic has been revamped to fit the pixel environment of the game. Also, its damage type has been changed to trap data so enemies will receive greater damage from the explosion and player can ignore the explosion with Trapper Potion artifact.
Reworked the Magic Gun artifact to no longer use the mana of weapon spells. The activation of the Magic Gun artifact will now occur without disrupting the player's ability to cast weapon spells.
Adjusted the strength of the Ice Monolith and Electric Bow, as they were more powerful than intended due to their mechanics.
Adjusted the strength of Wisp Summon minions.
Fixed an issue where the item statistics (performance and average) were not being kept, as in the base mode, in the Rampage Mode.
Arena mode's performance has been adjusted to behave the same way as the base mode, instead of the survivor mode (performance over a period of time).
Added control support for mouse + keyboard selection on survivor mode item reward.
Removed the display of negative numbers in the end result screen.
Fixed an issue where the Artifact dealing damage to summonable minions resulted in a net negative stat for the Spell Damage dealt statistic.
Fixed a case in which stun and knockback of players could go across scenes when the game was quit and returned while the player was stunned.
Fixed a typo and description of the Ice Nova spell.
Added a slight delay to the mouse control detect in the survivor mode item reward screen.
Adjusted the reroll Starting Spell Behaviour. Instead of looping through 50~60 spells, the rerolls will roll through the entire spell item library.
Increased the value of gems of gem spells. They count as "2" gems instead of 1 gem to address the issue of getting too weak in certain aspects after fixing a bug.
Adjusted the damages dealt by royal and imperial enemies that appear in Rampage Mode.
Fixed an issue where multiple Librarian Bag (possible by Emperor outfit) had multiplicative damage multipliers to each other instances of the artifact instead of additive damage multipliers.
Fixed an issue where multiple Dagger Locket artifacts had multiplicative damage multipliers to each other instances of the artifact. Adjusted the artifact's requirement a bit.
Fixed an issue the Survivor Upgrade Panel was not functioning properly with certain mouse or controller configuration.

Fixed an issue with Fire Wisp and Lightning Wisp not applying affliction as expected. Also, fixed an issue they have an unusual amount of duration. In addition, fire wisp and lightning wisp will apply elemental affliction to themselves which improves its elemental synergies with other artifacts, disks.
Improved the responsiveness of the survivor upgrade panel.
Added mouse control for the Survivor Upgrade Panel.
Fixed an issue with a text on Upgrade Panel on Survivor Upgrade Panel.
Fixed values on Arctic Shock upgrades in the survivor mode.
Increased UI text size for the Upgrade and Recycle indicators.
Fixed an issue where the upgrade panel was not visible due to the fade-out sequence of the item information panel.

Changed the upgrade behavior. Continuously pressing the upgrade button now requires releasing the button to proceed to the next level, preventing unintentional upgrades. This adjustment addresses the issue of mistakenly upgrading items. The behavior for the instant upgrade feature in the game remains unchanged.
Changed the dialogue of certain texts from the boss, which some people may find inappropriate. It also reflects the most lore-accurate nuance.
Upgrade indicator effect will now render at the correct position. It previously had a strange offset depending on various resolutions.

Adjusted Air Wisp by increasing its base damage. However, adjustments have been made to ensure that the extra damage is not increased by critical strikes. Allowing extra damage to critically strike resulted in a chain reaction of 1000 damage -> 2000 damage with a crit -> 4000 damage with a crit..., leading to an overflow of score values.
Fixed various summon spells that were not displaying the damage effect correctly.

Hi all,

We've been postponing these update posts because we didn't want to hinder the visibility of the 1.0 version update post. We wanted returning players to see the major changes in version 1.0 rather than a list of small patch notes and hotfixes that followed. Now that the sales are almost over, we'll resume posting our patch notes as usual. Here is the compiled list of the changes made since the release of version 1.0:
Spell Disk 1.0a (March, 2nd)
Added an auto weapon spell mode in the Settings menu. You can now enable or disable auto weapon spell modes at any time.
Fine-tuned and improved the logic and colliders in the inventory for smoother and more responsive mouse control.
Fixed the repeated selection sound in the inventory.
Fixed an issue where the weapon and outfit information would sometimes remain while hovering over an item, which occurred if you selected between two items repeatedly.
Fixed an issue where the item info panel would not disappear while hovering over the expand slot.
Fixed an issue where the memory gem's menu selection was initially not disabled, allowing you to click an invisible option on the screen to select a class.
Fixed an issue where the auto weapon spell did not function as configured in the Architect's
Chamber. Now, summoning dummies will make sure to follow the setting of auto-weapon spell casting mode of your choice.

Fixed some grammar and typos in dialogues and descriptions in certain languages.

First room in the Summoning Chamber will properly disable disk activation while walking up the stairs.

Fixed a case where Circlet Blade did not disappear upon unequipping the artifact.
Fixed an issue where the Fire Affliction Disk was not being affected by Pyromancer Cap accessory's effect.

Fixed a typo in the level mod.
Fixed an issue with the Circlet Blade artifact.

Fixed an issue the game would freeze when certain spells were spawned at specific location on shop / lobby.

Adjusted the name of the Architect Chamber in certain languages.
The refund-all upgrade option won't be interacted multiple times over several frames.

The upgrade cost will be displayed below the key instruction if you have the "Instant Upgrade" option enabled. Since it was not possible to check the amount of gems when upgrading was instant, it was causing unnecessary inconvenience.
Adjusted Rampage Mode's walls; it is no longer possible to dash through certain parts of the wall.
Changed the displayed information in the spell details.
Fixed an issue that occurred with Dash-Through Items (disk, artifacts) with the Rampage Mode walls.
Fixed a typo on Poison Flask artifact.
Fixed an issue where the run statistic was not properly being reset when progressing toward

Fixed an issue with the black bars in the Rampage Mode not hiding the Player UI.
Spell Disk 1.0g (March 7th)

Buffed Architect Outfit's effect. Dividing mana gained over many disks often made it appear like the outfit was not providing any mana to disks at all, so a flat mana value is additionally added onto disks as well.

Adjusted "...And More To Come!" default text comment from the beta days. While there are plans to add more features in the survivor upgrade, we don't want to appear as too promising as we aren't certain whether this new feature will come to a reality throughout development.
Adjusted the behavior of the Survivor Upgrade Chamber. It will show its panel only when interacted, rather than being near the object.
Fixed an issue where certain gem spells provided more gems than intended. To adjust for this change, slime gem accessory's gem requirement has been reduced from 30 gems to 18 gems.
Corrected order of damage manipulation before recording the stat for the damage dealt (shown in the damage dealt this stage). One instance of example being

Archer hat accessory. Its % damage change was applied after the stat for recording damage dealt has been recorded. It sometimes resulted in negative values due to the discrepancy between damage recorded vs actual damage dealt.

Optimized and adjusted the logic for damage and affliction dealt to summoned spell minions. While damage dealt was properly being adjusted, the affliction record was unaccounted for. It has changed since this version.
Negative signs will be removed from the damage stat.
Improved the responsiveness of the Survivor Upgrade Selection.
When closing an inventory while standing on top of an item on the floor, item information will be displayed again without having to exit its collider and re-entering it to show the information again.
Inventory Close button will return to the last selected inventory slot upon pressing down button.

Added highlight for expansion slot upon selection.
Fixed an issue with Cryomancer outfit and summonable spell minions.

Fixed an issue where enemies could spawn inside the walls on certain maps. Enemies are programmed to appear with a distance between them to avoid spawning on top of each other. However, when too many enemies spawn quickly (possibly by defeating them very rapidly), the entire map could be marked as a "too close to another enemy" zone. In such cases, a random position on a floor tile was chosen as the summon location. This, however, led to problems because wall tiles were sometimes painted over floor tiles, creating a probability that enemies could spawn inside walls. The logic for enemy summon locations has been adjusted and improved to prevent this issue in the future.

Similar issues could theoretically occur with the bosses as well, although it was far less likely due to the size and frequency of the minion spawns. Instead of a "random point on the floor" as a last resort, the player's position will be set as the safe position to spawn and move.
Fixed the pixel size scale on the summoning chamber, architect boss room, architect chamber, and arena. Now, the pixel size of the floors on those levels is consistent with other pixels in the game.

Adjusted the rate at which champion enemies appear in the arena mode. Also, increased the insight gain based on time—this change was made so that players who can't get too far in the arena mode also get rewarded. In other terms, the lower end of insight gain was increased, and the higher end of insight gain in arena mode was reduced.

Fixed an issue where you could interact with your inventory using mouse control while choosing an item. Addressed various issues, such as the inability to move selected item slots in the inventory, which occurred with the control update focusing on mouse control.

Adjusted the score UI location for the architect chamber. Players were getting scores far greater than we anticipated!
Improved inventory navigation by removing a tiny amount of rightward bias that existed in the inventory selection.

Corrected item descriptions for some artifact items.

Fixed an issue gem of 5 value was incorrectly being assigned with gem 1 sprites.

Removed blurred pixel from the spear's charge attack. Collider size and damage has not been adjusted, as it is only graphical change.

Auto Charge Gauntlet now activates charging-related items while passively charging the charge meter.

Fixed an issue where the slow trap modifier would not appear in Summoning Chambers.

Fixed an issue Chained Balls artifact could cause some frame drops because it was not recycling the effect object as intended. It also may have caused some memory issues leading to weird behaviors in the game.
Fixed a problem where certain sound effects, such as the stair walking noise, were not affected by the 'effect sound' slider bar in the settings menu.
